Senior Data Analyst at P2P.org, the largest institutional staking provider | Remote, GMT +-3/ Cyprus | Full-time Contractor

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work on validation economics, blockchain ecosystem research, and end-to-end data solutions — from modeling and experimentation to dashboards and data platform setup (BigQuery, Python, Airflow/DBT). Crypto experience is a must.

The role involves close collaboration with internal teams, ownership of data marts and reporting, and supporting decisions around yield optimization, new networks, and risk/opportunity analysis across the staking and restaking landscape.

Please apply on: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/p2p.org/1a780127-c77f-44c3-802b-501...
